hotels.title: Secluded Bali Beachfront Hideaway with Daily Breakfast, Daily Lunch or Dinner & Massages
hotels.description: Set between the shimmering ocean and the majestic Mount Agung - Bali’s most sacred mountain - this luxurious resort boasts an idyllic location that is the perfect base from which to explore Bali’s blissfully unspoiled east coast. A secluded, well-kept Balinese secret, this is a destination where true bliss awaits. The long, ocean-facing pool is the heart of the resort, framed by coconut palms with the strait stretching out beyond. Pamper yourself with a heavenly massage at Spa Alila, indulge in traditional Indonesian cuisine at Seasalt restaurant or unwind on one of the sunloungers lining the main swimming pool, where you can take in stunning ocean views as you soak up the sun. Enjoy a complimentary daily shuttle to Candidasa, visit Tirta Gangga Water Palace and Taman Ujung’s water gardens within 30 minutes by car, or head to Padangbai Harbour for fast boats to the Gili Islands.
